basic_details.job_title: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Sports Manager, Female Gym Instructor Posts
basic_details.short_information: Nalanda University, Rajgir, an institution of National Importance under the aegis of the Ministry of External Affairs, has invited applications for two non-teaching posts on contract on consolidated pay: Sports Manager (1 post) and Female Gym Instructor (1 post). Each engagement is for 1 year initially, with negotiable pay. Fill the Google Form and forward its copy with a single PDF of documents to [email protected] on or before 27 November 2026. The application fee is Rs. 500/- (including GST).

how_to_apply: The application has two mandatory stages: filling the Google Form, and forwarding its copy with documents to the Recruitment Cell. No hard copy of the application is accepted.
Log in to a Gmail account before opening the application link, because the form is a Google Form. Create a Gmail account first if you do not have one.
Open the application link given at the end of the advertisement or on the University website, fill in the form carefully and submit it.
After submission, a copy of the filled Application Form arrives on your registered email.
Forward that copy (do not compose a separate email) from the same email address to [email protected].

Attach one single PDF file containing the updated CV with passport size photograph, qualification certificates and mark sheets (graduation onward only), experience certificates and other relevant supporting documents.

Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- (including GST) online directly to the University's bank account through Net Banking / UPI, and write the UTR Number / Transaction Reference Number in the Application Form.
Send the forwarded email on or before 27 November 2026. Filling the form alone does not complete the application.
The enclosure must be a single PDF file only. Multiple files, separate emails, or ZIP, RAR or other compressed formats lead to rejection.
Use the same email address for filling the Application Form and forwarding it.
Do not send the documents separately or through multiple or part-wise emails.
Scan documents with a proper scanner in a clean, legible and printable format. Tilted, distorted, unclear or cropped scans, particularly those made with mobile phones, may lead to rejection.
Submit only ONE application for each post. Multiple applications or emails for the same post may lead to rejection.
important_instructions: Candidates currently working in a government body, autonomous body or Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) when called for an interview or selection process. Applications received after the closing date are rejected, and no correspondence is entertained. The candidate is responsible for the information filled in the Application Form. No TA/DA is paid for appearing for the selection process. Changes of dates are communicated by publishing on the University website, so candidates are asked to visit it regularly. Nalanda University reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions and to fill or not fill the advertised posts. Any other applicable rule is followed even if not mentioned in the notice.

content_sections.heading: About Nalanda University
content_sections.text: Nalanda University, Rajgir is described in the notice as an avant-garde "International" University, designated as an institution of "National Importance" and established by an Act of the Indian Parliament (Nalanda University Act, 2010) under the aegis of the Ministry of External Affairs, GOI. The recruitment is handled by its Recruitment Cell, and the notice is signed by the Registrar (I/C).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 2 posts in total, one for each position. It gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. The qualifications and experience below are the minimum requirements, and meeting them does not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. Preferred: Master's degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.), Sports Science, Sports Management, Physical Education & Sports, or an equivalent relevant discipline from a recognized institution. Experience: minimum 5 years of relevant experience in university/college sports, sports administration, facility management, coaching, sports academy operations or a comparable environment. Recognised coaching certification/diploma from SAI/NSNIS, National Sports Federation or another recognised institution will be an advantage. Demonstrated coaching expertise in at least one recognised sport is desirable. Participation/coaching experience at University, State, National or International level will be an added advantage. Experience in managing sports facilities, organising tournaments, handling equipment/inventory and developing student teams will be strongly preferred. Desired competencies: hands-on, energetic and student-oriented, with strong leadership, coaching, planning and execution capabilities. The role requires regular on-field presence and willingness to work during early mornings, evenings and weekends, depending on training and competition schedules. Experience: minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a Gym Instructor, Fitness Trainer, Personal Trainer or Strength & Conditioning Trainer or Physical education & Health Teacher. Prior experience working in a University, educational institution, sports centre, fitness centre or professional gym will be an advantage. The notice also lists "Certification in sports and sporty injury" under experience. Desired skills: sound knowledge of fitness training, strength and conditioning, gym equipment, exercise techniques and safety protocols; strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable working closely with students. The ideal candidate should be energetic, disciplined, approachable and hands-on, with a strong commitment to promoting fitness and well-being within the University community. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) / Sports Science / Exercise & Fitness / related discipline from a recognized institution

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts are engaged on contract on consolidated pay, and the notice states the pay as "Negotiable" without any amount. The engagement is for 01 year initially and is extendable subject to satisfactory performance and the requirement of the University. A selected candidate must be ready to join immediately.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Sports Infrastructure & Facilities: oversee the day-to-day functioning, utilisation and upkeep of playgrounds, courts, gymnasium, indoor/outdoor sports facilities and equipment; coordinate maintenance, repairs and infrastructure upgrades. Sports Planning & Execution: develop and execute the University's annual sports calendar, including regular activities, tournaments, leagues, annual sports meets, fitness initiatives and recreational programmes. Coaching & Student Development: conduct/supervise regular coaching and practice sessions, identify sporting talent, mentor students, develop University teams and prepare students for competitive events. Competitions & Events: organise intra-University and inter-university competitions and coordinate team selection, registrations, equipment, travel and other logistics. Sports Administration: maintain records of facilities, equipment, inventory, student participation and achievements; support procurement and budget planning; prepare periodic reports. Team & Stakeholder Coordination: coordinate with coaches, trainers, ground staff and relevant University departments for smooth and safe conduct of all sporting activities. Student Engagement & Sports Culture: drive participation across the student community while promoting fitness, teamwork, discipline, sportsmanship and competitive excellence. Supervise the day-to-day functioning of the women's gymnasium, games and physical education, and ensure a safe, disciplined and welcoming fitness environment. Conduct regular fitness, strength, conditioning, mobility and general exercise sessions for students. Guide users on the correct and safe use of gym equipment, exercise techniques and appropriate workout routines. Develop basic individual and group fitness programmes based on fitness levels and goals. Monitor students during workouts and provide guidance on posture, form, warm-up, cool-down and injury prevention. Conduct basic fitness assessments and track progress, wherever required. Ensure gym equipment is properly used, maintained and stored; promptly report maintenance or safety concerns. Maintain required records related to gym usage, equipment and activities. Support the University in organising fitness challenges, wellness activities, sports camps and related student-engagement initiatives. Ensure adherence to University rules, gym timings, safety standards and hygiene protocols.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice mentions shortlisting followed by an interview. Incomplete application forms are not considered for shortlisting, and the criteria of shortlisting follow the institutional requirements and norms. Where many applications are received, the University reserves the right to limit the number of candidates called for further stages based on qualifications, experience and overall suitability. The interview is held in Offline / Online mode as applicable. Timings are shared by email only, after scrutiny of applications. Shortlisted candidates and the selected candidate are informed by email only, so applicants should give a correct and active email ID. The decision of the University on all selection matters is final and binding, and no candidate can claim an appointment letter as a right, even after the Selection (Interview) Committee recommends them.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Nalanda University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Sports Manager and 1 Female Gym Instructor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Sports Manager?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education, with minimum 5 years of relevant experience. A Master's degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.), Sports Science, Sports Management or an equivalent discipline is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Female Gym Instructor?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) / Sports Science / Exercise & Fitness / related discipline from a recognized institution, with minimum 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500/- (including GST), paid online to the University's bank account through Net Banking / UPI. The UTR / transaction reference number must be written in the Application Form.

faq.answer: Fill the Google Form, then forward the copy received on your registered email to [email protected] with one single PDF of your CV and documents. Both steps must be done by 27 November 2026.
